name: earthquake-usgs
description: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program (Latest Earthquakes map). This CLI queries real-time earthquake feeds, the ComCat FDSN event search and count APIs, event details with products such as PAGER, ShakeMap and aftershock forecasts, geoserve nearby-place and region lookups, and catalog/contributor metadata.

commands.name: get-feed
commands.summary: Get a real-time earthquake summary feed (GeoJSON) for a magnitude threshold and time window, e.g. M2.5+ past day or significant past month

params.name: magnitude
params.description: Magnitude threshold of the feed, or 'significant' for significant events only

commands.name: search-earthquakes
commands.summary: Search the ComCat earthquake catalog (FDSN) by time range, magnitude, bounding box or radius, depth, PAGER alert level and event type, with sorting and paging

params.name: starttime
params.description: Start time, ISO 8601 date or datetime in UTC, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00. Defaults server-side to 30 days ago.

params.name: endtime
params.description: End time, ISO 8601 date or datetime in UTC. Defaults to now.

params.name: minlatitude
params.description: Bounding box south edge, decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

params.name: maxlatitude
params.description: Bounding box north edge, decimal degrees

params.name: minlongitude
params.description: Bounding box west edge, decimal degrees (-360 to 360)

params.name: maxlongitude
params.description: Bounding box east edge, decimal degrees

params.name: latitude
params.description: Center latitude for a radius search (use together with longitude and maxradiuskm)

params.name: longitude
params.description: Center longitude for a radius search

params.name: maxradiuskm
params.description: Search radius in km around latitude/longitude (max 20001.6)

params.name: alertlevel
params.description: Limit to events with this PAGER alert level

params.name: eventtype
params.description: Event type, e.g. earthquake, quarry blast, explosion (see get-catalog-metadata eventtypes)

params.name: catalog
params.description: Limit to a catalog, e.g. us, ak, ci (see get-catalog-metadata catalogs)

params.name: producttype
params.description: Only events that have this product type, e.g. shakemap, losspager, dyfi, moment-tensor

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-20000) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: 1-based index of the first result to return, used for paging

commands.name: count-earthquakes
commands.summary: Count catalog events that match search filters (time, magnitude, location radius or bbox, depth, event type) without downloading them

params.name: latitude
params.description: Center latitude for a radius filter (use with longitude and maxradiuskm)

params.name: longitude
params.description: Center longitude for a radius filter

commands.name: get-event
commands.summary: Get full detail for one earthquake event by id, including all products (origin, shakemap, losspager, dyfi, moment-tensor, oaf) and their content file URLs

params.name: eventid
params.description: Event id as returned in feed or search results (feature id), e.g. us6000u18k

commands.name: get-aftershock-forecast
commands.summary: Get the aftershock forecast (oaf product forecast.json: observed counts, model parameters, probabilities) for an event's oaf product

params.name: productId
params.description: Full oaf product id from get-event properties.products.oaf[0].id, e.g. urn:usgs-product:us:oaf:us6000u18k:1792252672761

commands.name: get-shakemap-contours
commands.summary: Get ShakeMap intensity (MMI) contour lines as GeoJSON for an event's shakemap product

params.name: productId
params.description: Full shakemap product id from get-event properties.products.shakemap[0].id, e.g. urn:usgs-product:us:shakemap:us6000u2mq:1792208324795

commands.name: find-nearby-places
commands.summary: Find populated places (GeoNames) near a latitude/longitude within a radius, optionally filtered by minimum population

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of places to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-event-places
commands.summary: Get the 5 reference places the event page lists near an epicenter (distance and azimuth), as used in event titles

commands.name: get-regions
commands.summary: Get regional info for a lat/lon: admin region/country, Flinn-Engdahl region, authoritative network, NEIC catalog/response regions, offshore and tectonic summary

commands.name: get-catalog-metadata
commands.summary: List the allowed values for FDSN search filters: catalogs, contributors, product types, event types and magnitude types

commands.name: list-contributors
commands.summary: List ComCat contributing seismic networks with id, full name, aliases and info URL

notes: Times in GeoJSON responses (properties.time, properties.updated) are Unix epoch milliseconds in UTC. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude, depth_km].

search-earthquakes paging: offset is 1-based and limit maxes out at 20000. Without starttime, the server defaults to the last 30 days. Use count-earthquakes first for large queries; it returns maxAllowed=20000.
Use either a bounding box (min/max latitude/longitude) or a radius (latitude + longitude + maxradiuskm), not both.
Event ids come from the feature 'id' field in get-feed or search-earthquakes results. Pass them to get-event.

To get product contents, read the product id from get-event: properties.products.<type>[0].id, e.g. oaf for get-aftershock-forecast and shakemap for get-shakemap-contours. Each product's 'contents' map also gives direct URLs for every file (PAGER XML, DYFI GeoJSON, and others).
Summary feeds update about every minute. 'significant' is chosen by the USGS significance score and PAGER alert, not by magnitude.
No authentication is needed. All endpoints are public USGS APIs.
